recording.channel: Term 5 (EL5101-0011).ENC TxPdo 1 Samples Counter value.Counter value[0]

definitions.deviation: settled position minus target, machine coordinates, with the phase mean removed
definitions.B: x̄ forward minus x̄ reverse at one target
definitions.M: mean of the two directions at one target
definitions.A: max(x̄ + 2s) − min(x̄ − 2s) over all targets and directions
definitions.gain: straight line through M against target position
definitions.screw: M minus that line, grouped by whether the target is a whole or a half turn of the 2 mm screw from zero

settling_model.gain_source: phase 4, averaged over both approach directions
